Keep towels organized and within reach while freeing up valuable bathroom space in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. This 3-tier hotel-style towel shelf with drying rack uses a wall mount design to add storage without cluttering your floor.

- Create more storage for folded towels and linens
- Hang and dry towels efficiently on the rack-style arms
- Save space with a wall-mounted, traditional look
- Install cleanly with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Choose from a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Specs: Overall size 24.7 in L x 10.4 in H x 8.9 in W; projection 3.5 in. Material: brass. Mounting: wall mount. Assembly: some assembly required. Included: towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware. Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty. Weight: 5.6 lb.
